summary: First-run E2E testing of COSMIC WEAVER // VEYL STUDIO. All 6 backend pytest cases passed (/api/, /api/takes CRUD, /api/takes/{unknown} 404, /api/progress upsert & get, /api/stats shape & aggregation). Full frontend flow verified in headless Chromium via SIM boot: canvas renders, 3D avatar visible, rig telemetry shows FACE/BODY/HAND TRACK · SIM, all 5 scene chips switch worlds, all 5 expression chips + glitch-burst work, hotkeys 1-5 & q/w/e/r/t work, voice preset & sliders update, teleprompter opens on script-item-1 with the correct hook line 'They told you space is silent. They lied.', pillar filters work, prompter-close hides overlay. Critical recording flow: click record-btn -> rec-timer counted, teleprompter auto-advanced beats during recording (beat 3/5 observed at ~6s + additional beats at ~18s), STOP triggered a .webm download (transmission-01-take-040042.webm, 300KB VP9/Opus), take appeared in takes-panel with SAVE link, POST /api/takes persisted (verified via GET), and POST /api/progress/1 marked script 1 recorded. Zero console errors during entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Studio.jsx is ~300 lines and readable; recorder/stage/tracker/voice are cleanly modularised — good separation.
Backend server.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection and uses uuid ids — good.
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router (order works with Starlette but conventionally middlewares are added before routes) — non-blocking.

toggleRec generates client-side take entry id via Date.now() which does NOT match the server-generated uuid returned from POST /api/takes; if UI later needs server id it will diverge. Currently unused, so no functional impact.
No DELETE call to /api/takes/{id} is fired when a take is removed via the UI trash icon (TakesPanel onDelete only removes locally). If persistence-across-sessions is desired, hook DELETE too.
test_credentials: None — no auth in this app (confirmed via /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Created a take + progress entry during E2E; cleaned up (deleted take ef3aa913... and reset progress/1 to false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints are stable and covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend recording works end-to-end in headless via SIM mode; use boot-sim-btn, then click script-item-1 before record-btn to also exercise progress marking. Use expect_download to catch the auto-download. Backend URL: env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified via curl that MongoDB _id is never exposed.
